MAD ALCHEMIST, FINAL PUPPET
CR 11

XP 12,800
CE Large undead
Init +4, Senses Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 14, flat-footed 22 (+4 Dex, +3 natural, +7 armor, +2 shield)
hp 200 (body) 75 (strings)
Fort +5, Ref +13 Will +9
SQ undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 corrosive scimitar +22/17/12 (1d6 +10 slashing +1d6 acid) or Bite +19/+14/+9 (2d6 +8 piercing plus venom)
Space 10 ft., Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks constrict 2d8 +7

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 18, Con -, Int -, Wis -, Cha –
Base Atk +11; CMB +19 (+23 grapple), CMD 32

SPECIAL ABILITIES

On Strings (Ex)

The strings of the mad alchemist can be attacked. They use the same armor class as hi m, but are immune to spells. If the strings are brought to zero hit points, then he dies instantly. The strings are vulnerable to slashing damage, and immune to bludgeoning. They have standard object immunities.

Bind (Su)

A creature struck by any of this creature’s melee attacks must make a Reflex save DC 16. If it fails, the creature is bound in strings, giving it the grappled condition. This persists until the creature uses a standard action to make a DC 16 Strength check or Escape Artist check to break out.

Dancing Strings (Ex)

Once per round, a single melee or ranged attack that hits the strings instead counts as a miss. It may not be the first hit on the strings in that round.

Venom (Ex)

the mad alchemist has augmented his own form with elixirs to give himself a powerful venom.

Type poison (injury); save Fortitude DC 17; onset immediate; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds ; cure 2 consecutive saves 1d4 Constitution damage, 1d4 Strength damage.

Death Throes (Su)

When the mad alchemist is kill ed, he explodes in a blinding flash of fire that deals 50 points of fire damage. Anything within 100 feet (Reflex DC 18 halves). If the mad alchemist dies by having his strings cut rather than his body being destroyed, his body swells up for 2 full rounds before this ability occurs.
